description: This file defines the AdbMessage class, which encapsulates and manages ADB command packets, including setting command headers, handling data buffers, and communication with USB devices.

classes.name: AdbMessage
classes.description: Represents an ADB command packet with methods to set command data, read/write to USB, and generate string representations.

methods.name: AdbMessage
methods.description: Constructor initializing message and data buffers with little-endian byte order.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the command header fields with command, arguments, and data.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Overloaded method to set command and arguments without data.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Overloaded method to set command, arguments, and string data with trailing zero.

methods.name: getArg0
methods.description: Returns the first argument of the command.

methods.name: getArg1
methods.description: Returns the second argument of the command.

methods.name: getDataLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the data.

methods.name: getDataString
methods.description: Returns the data as a string, trimming trailing zero.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes the message to a USB device, queuing message and data requests.

methods.name: readCommand
methods.description: Queues a request to read the command header.

methods.name: readData
methods.description: Queues a request to read data of specified length.

methods.name: extractString
methods.description: Extracts a string from a ByteBuffer at a given offset and length.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the AdbMessage.

methods.name: checksum
methods.description: Calculates checksum of byte array data.
